beats.say: Chile is the strangest shaped country on Earth.
beats.title: CHILE MAKES NO SENSE

beats.say: It's about four thousand three hundred kilometers long, but on average only around one hundred eighty kilometers wide.
Now drop it on Europe, at the same size.
It would stretch from the Arctic in Norway almost down to North Africa.
In the north, the Atacama, one of the driest deserts on Earth. In the south, glaciers and fjords.
One country, almost every climate on the planet. Follow for more.
beats.title: ONE COUNTRY. EVERY CLIMATE.
